name: Eris
source: Eris has been by Nyarbalte's side longer than anyone, and serves the god with unquestioning devotion. They've been through this so many times that they are very over it at this point. They are the caretaker of Ellie, and the other inhabitants of the mansion. They are basically a very tired parent, and it shows!
